verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is API-driven: onboarding, balance retrieval and testing can all be done through the Stripe API, and an official Stripe CLI is documented, so programmatic, non-UI operation is evidenced. Nothing explicitly documents running the CLI or integration in CI pipelines or headless automation, and the CLI evidence is only a probe link. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage documentation (e.g., CI auth via API keys, non-interactive CLI mode), CLI capability details for Connect, independent corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: API onboarding: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
Before going live, test your Connect integration for account creation, identity verification, and payouts.
